title: Spyglass Has Arrived!
summary: The innovative Spyglass tool has moved from beta to general availability, ready to empower your work with its advanced features.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage and display all your embedded files exactly how you want them, giving you complete creative control within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dedicated page where you can easily explore our completed features, current priorities, and upcoming plans, keeping you informed every step of the way.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to drag, and visually consistent with the rest of the editor, enhancing your task management.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and intuitive real-time collaboration experience, making teamwork easier and more connected than ever.

title: Enhanced Discovery for Shared Content
summary: Discover shared ideas and content faster than ever, empowering more effective collaboration through enhanced search.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering users with greater control and direct involvement in its exciting future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, connecting users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Vibrant New Themes
summary: We're refreshing our existing themes and introducing an exciting collection of brand-new looks to personalize your experience and make your workspace truly shine.

title: Powerful Graph View Enhancements
summary: We're introducing advanced filtering capabilities to the Graph View, empowering you to explore connections, discover shared items, and kickstart your workflows with unprecedented ease.

title: Master Your Knowledge with Advanced Search & Organization
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most vital information using powerful new search filters, which can be saved as personalized Compendiums for instant access whenever you need them.

title: Dynamic Content Displays
summary: Experience a powerful new way to organize and display your connected ideas, tasks, and sources, tailored precisely to your thinking.

title: Noeko Self-Hosted & Enterprise Plans
summary: We are thrilled to introduce Noeko's self-hosted deployment options and flexible enterprise plans, empowering organizations with greater control and access to advanced features.

title: Smarter Welcome Messages
summary: We are fine-tuning our application to deliver greetings that perfectly align with your local time, ensuring a consistently accurate and welcoming experience.

title: Direct Tag Content Control
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content, including the ability to quickly unapply or delete items, directly from your tag views for ultimate organizational efficiency.

title: Broaden Your Knowledge Base with More Source Types
summary: Effortlessly import and interact with a wider variety of content, such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to centralize all your valuable information.
